'''Bristing''' was a blooming [[Plant/Legends|plant]] that grew in fields along the shores of the [[Silver Sea/Legends|Silver Sea]],<ref name="NJO Rebirth" /> a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] located near [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]].<ref name="CatCW">''[[Coruscant and the Core Worlds]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Bristing appeared in [[Greg Keyes]]'s [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', the eighth volume of the series ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]''.<ref name="NJO Rebirth" />

==Appearances==
